text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Today's lunch is yakisoba pan~♪ Feeling 
so good, GO, GO, GO~♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship invited me to have lunch on the 
rooftop, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whooosh~......)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Yo, look at you looking all cheerful 
today.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: N-Nakayama...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In an instant! The air in the room froze 
solid!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The fierce aura radiating from Nakayama 
Festa as a gambler has completely 
overwhelmed Gold Ship...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
(She's giving off an even edgier vibe than 
usual today... Is she planning to pull 
something on me...!?)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... Don't make such a frightened 
face. It just makes me want to challenge 
you right here and now.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: A match, you say...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, there's something I want to try out 
a bit. —Sugoroku, to be specific."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sugoroku"...!! A traditional Japanese 
board game where players compete to reach 
the goal first!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
"How about it? I feel like you and I could 
have one heated showdown."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Call it a heated showdown, and 
there's no way I can keep quiet...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Warning—!! If she accepts the match, Gold 
Ship's fired-up personality means it might 
not finish before lunch break is over!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Should I send her out to compete here...!? 
Or should I stop her... !?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, Trainer. I've got a match to 
settle. Go ahead and eat lunch without me.
choice_data_list: No, let me do it instead
No, let me do it instead

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Sorry, Trainer. I've got a match to 
settle. Go ahead and eat lunch without me.
choice_data_list: No, let me do it instead
No, let me do it instead

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: What...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're interested in competing too, 
huh...? Nice, sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: It's settled! Today, I'm taking you on!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa, whoa, seriously?! Am I completely 
left out in the cold here?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I'm going to fight, I'll give it 
everything I have...!! That was my 
resolve, but—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Haa, that was over quick.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Despite our best efforts, we were 
defeated...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*, fully charged. Now then, about 
the match—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, aren't you losing? Well, I got to 
rest, so whatever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To win, one needs the corresponding 
resolve and spirit. I was once again 
reminded that the competitive world is not 
forgiving...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hell yeah, leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh... All right, roll the dice. 
Highest roll goes first.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And the showdown begins! A fierce battle 
between these two Umamusume is officially 
underway!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Several hours in—!! The battle has grown 
white-hot, reaching its climax!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... I can't clear it! No matter how 
many times I roll the dice, I can't land 
exactly on the goal!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just when it looks like she's about to 
reach the goal, Gold Ship can't roll the 
exact number and gets sent back over and 
over...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Four more to go...!! Please, let me pull 
off the exact win this time!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Show me, then! Show me that "heavenly 
luck" of yours...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship is praying!! What will the dice 
roll reveal—!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Plop!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Th-This is...!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOO--!! A "4"!! I rolled a 
"4"-ooooo--!! I've wonnnnnnn--!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: ...Heeh, you've got quite the stash here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeaaaah!! Witness my legendary 
luuuuck!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I feel like I could take on any 
challenge! Be it the local squid fishing 
tournament or a massive Grand Prix-level 
race!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Through sheer grit and tenacity—she takes 
the victory!! Gold Ship seizes a 
magnificent win!!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
A "6" right here?! Hahaha, straight back 
to start for you!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Nwooooh~~!! What in the world am I 
doinggggg?!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps this turn of events was the 
catalyst... Gold Ship ended up suffering 
defeat...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Haaah, I lost...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"It's no use, I can't find any meaning in 
living... Even standing up is too much of 
a pain now..."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer... Carry me back to the 
dorms..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A completely burned-out Gold Ship lost all 
will to do anything...
